items.text:
時間： O(n log n)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Merge-sort indexed inversion counts
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countSmaller(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        answer = [0] * len(nums)

        def sort(items):
            if len(items) <= 1:
                return items
            middle = len(items) // 2
            left, right = sort(items[:middle]), sort(items[middle:])
            i = j = 0
            merged = []
            while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
                if left[i][0] <= right[j][0]:
                    answer[left[i][1]] += j
                    merged.append(left[i])
                    i += 1
                else:
                    merged.append(right[j])
                    j += 1
            for value, index in left[i:]:
                answer[index] += j
                merged.append((value, index))
            merged.extend(right[j:])
            return merged

        sort([(value, i) for i, value in enumerate(nums)])
        return answer

items.title: 1. 剩餘次數與單調堆疊
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(A)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Monotone stack with remaining counts
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(A)
    """

    def removeDuplicateLetters(self, s: str) -> str:
        from collections import Counter

        remaining = Counter(s)
        stack, used = [], set()
        for character in s:
            remaining[character] -= 1
            if character in used:
                continue
            while stack and stack[-1] > character and remaining[stack[-1]]:
                used.remove(stack.pop())
            stack.append(character)
            used.add(character)
        return "".join(stack)

items.title: 2. 遞迴選取最小的可行首字母
items.text:
時間： O(A*n)

空間： O(A*n)，包含保留中的切片

class Solution:
    """Approach: Choose the smallest feasible first letter recursively
    Time: O(A*n)
    Space: O(A*n) including retained slices
    """

    def removeDuplicateLetters(self, s: str) -> str:
        def choose(text):
            if not text:
                return ""
            last = {character: index for index, character in enumerate(text)}
            boundary = min(last.values())
            position = min(range(boundary + 1), key=lambda index: text[index])
            character = text[position]
            return character + choose(text[position + 1 :].replace(character, ""))

        return choose(s)

items.title: 自底向上的金額表
items.text: dp[x] 為金額 x 的最少硬幣數，dp[0]=0，其餘設為 amount+1。因面額至少為一，此哨兵大於任何可行答案。金額遞增處理，對每個不大於目前金額的面額，考慮 dp[total-coin]+1。目標仍為哨兵則回傳 -1。

items.title: 金額狀態的廣度優先搜尋
items.text: 把 0 到 A 的金額視為頂點，加一枚硬幣視為邊。從零 BFS，入列時標記金額，首次到達目標時回傳距離；C 是面額數。

items.title: 自底向上的金額表
items.text: 任何非空組合都有最後一枚硬幣，移除後是已求解的小金額。試遍最後面額不會漏掉最佳組合；每個有限候選也都由可達的小金額延伸而來，因此合法。歸納可證每項皆最優。

items.title: 金額狀態的廣度優先搜尋
items.text: 每條邊恰用一枚硬幣，因此 BFS 層數等於硬幣數。每個合法組合都對應一條路徑，第一次到達即最少枚數；搜尋耗盡則證明無解。

items.title: 範例推演
items.text: 面額 [2,5]、金額 7 中，2 與 5 各需一枚。7 可在 5 後加 2，或在 2 後加 5，皆需兩枚；金額 3 仍無法湊出。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text:
自底向上的金額表：時間 O(A*C)；空間 O(A)。

金額狀態的廣度優先搜尋：時間 O(A*C)；空間 O(A)。

預設法需 O(amount * number_of_coins) 時間、O(amount) 空間，不改輸入。金額遞增允許同一面額重複使用。最大面額優先的貪婪會在 [1,3,4]、目標 6 失敗。BFS 可提早停止，但需佇列與已訪集合；正面額保證只需考慮不超過目標的有限狀態。

時間： O(A*C)

空間： O(A)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bottom-up amount table
    Time: O(A*C)
    Space: O(A)
    """

    def coinChange(self, coins: list[int], amount: int) -> int:
        impossible = amount + 1
        dp = [impossible] * (amount + 1)
        dp[0] = 0
        for total in range(1, amount + 1):
            for coin in coins:
                if coin <= total:
                    dp[total] = min(dp[total], dp[total - coin] + 1)
        return -1 if dp[amount] == impossible else dp[amount]

items.title: 2. 金額狀態的廣度優先搜尋
items.text:
時間： O(A*C)

空間： O(A)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Breadth-first sums
    Time: O(A*C)
    Space: O(A)
    """

    def coinChange(self, coins: list[int], amount: int) -> int:
        from collections import deque

        queue = deque([(0, 0)])
        seen = {0}
        while queue:
            total, count = queue.popleft()
            if total == amount:
                return count
            for coin in coins:
                following = total + coin
                if following <= amount and following not in seen:
                    seen.add(following)
                    queue.append((following, count + 1))
        return -1

items.text:
時間： O(n log n)

空間： O(n)

from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Merge-sort prefix difference counting
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countRangeSum(self, nums: list[int], lower: int, upper: int) -> int:
        prefix = [0]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)

        def sort(values):
            if len(values) <= 1:
                return values, 0
            middle = len(values) // 2
            left, first = sort(values[:middle])
            right, second = sort(values[middle:])
            answer = first + second
            low = high = 0
            for value in left:
                while low < len(right) and right[low] - value < lower:
                    low += 1
                while high < len(right) and right[high] - value <= upper:
                    high += 1
                answer += high - low
            merged = []
            i = j = 0
            while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
                if left[i] <= right[j]:
                    merged.append(left[i])
                    i += 1
                else:
                    merged.append(right[j])
                    j += 1
            merged.extend(left[i:])
            merged.extend(right[j:])
            return merged, answer

        return sort(prefix)[1]

items.title: 2. 壓縮 Fenwick 前綴計數
items.text:
時間： O(n log n)

空間： O(n)

from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Compressed Fenwick prefix counts
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def countRangeSum(self, nums: list[int], lower: int, upper: int) -> int:
        prefix = [0]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
        ordered = sorted(set(prefix))
        bit = [0] * (len(ordered) + 1)

        def count(end):
            result = 0
            while end:
                result += bit[end]
                end -= end & -end
            return result

        answer = 0
        for value in prefix:
            answer += count(bisect_right(ordered, value - lower)) - count(
                bisect_left(ordered, value - upper)
            )
            index = bisect_left(ordered, value) + 1
            while index < len(bit):
                bit[index] += 1
                index += index & -index
        return answer

items.title: 1. 分離交錯位置鏈
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(1)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Split interleaved position chains
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def oddEvenList(self, head: ListNode | None) -> ListNode | None:
        if head is None:
            return None
        odd, even = head, head.next
        even_head = even
        while even and even.next:
            odd.next = even.next
            odd = odd.next
            even.next = odd.next
            even = even.next
        odd.next = even_head
        return head

items.title: 2. 依位置索引的參照分組
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(n)

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Position-indexed reference groups
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def oddEvenList(self, head: ListNode | None) -> ListNode | None:
        groups = [[], []]
        index = 0
        while head:
            groups[index % 2].append(head)
            head = head.next
            index += 1
        ordered = groups[0] + groups[1]
        for index, node in enumerate(ordered):
            node.next = ordered[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(ordered) else None
        return ordered[0] if ordered else None

items.text:
時間： O(R*C)

空間： O(R*C)

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Topological indegree layers
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def longestIncreasingPath(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows, columns = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])

        def neighbors(row: int, column: int):
            for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                other_row, other_column = row + dr, column + dc
                if 0 <= other_row < rows and 0 <= other_column < columns:
                    yield other_row, other_column

        indegree = [[0] * columns for _ in range(rows)]
        queue = deque()
        for row in range(rows):
            for column in range(columns):
                indegree[row][column] = sum(
                    matrix[nr][nc] < matrix[row][column] for nr, nc in neighbors(row, column)
                )
                if indegree[row][column] == 0:
                    queue.append((row, column))
        layers = 0
        while queue:
            layers += 1
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                row, column = queue.popleft()
                for nr, nc in neighbors(row, column):
                    if matrix[nr][nc] > matrix[row][column]:
                        indegree[nr][nc] -= 1
                        if indegree[nr][nc] == 0:
                            queue.append((nr, nc))
        return layers

from collections import deque


class Solution:
    """Approach: Value-ordered path DP
    Time: O(R*C log(R*C))
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def longestIncreasingPath(self, matrix: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        rows, columns = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
        cells = sorted((matrix[r][c], r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(columns))
        best = [[1] * columns for _ in range(rows)]
        answer = 1
        for value, row, column in cells:
            for nr, nc in (
                (row - 1, column),
                (row + 1, column),
                (row, column - 1),
                (row, column + 1),
            ):
                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < columns and matrix[nr][nc] < value:
                    best[row][column] = max(best[row][column], best[nr][nc] + 1)
            answer = max(answer, best[row][column])
        return answer

items.title: 排序串列的 Hierholzer 遍歷
items.text: 迭代執行 Hierholzer。目的地以遞減順序儲存，從尾端取出就是最小者。堆疊保留目前路線；有未用邊便前進，否則彈出機場加入反向結果，最後反轉。

items.title: 堆積鄰接表的 Hierholzer 遍歷
items.text: 每個機場的出邊目的地放進最小堆積，取最小邊前進；直到該機場出邊堆積用完才記錄機場，最後反轉完成順序。

items.title: 排序串列的 Hierholzer 遍歷
items.text: 每張機票只移除一次。反向完成順序把找到的環接成完整歐拉路徑，讓行程終點分支排在其他分支之後。依序消耗較小目的地，會讓第一個可行差異最小；在保證有解下得到字典序最小完整行程。

items.title: 堆積鄰接表的 Hierholzer 遍歷
items.text: Hierholzer 後序把全部機票邊接成歐拉路徑，也能處理讓單純向前貪婪陷入死路的分支。保證有解時，先取最小邊會得到可行行程中字典序最小者。

items.title: 1. 排序串列的 Hierholzer 遍歷
items.text:
時間： O(E log E)

空間： O(E)

from collections import defaultdict


class Solution:
    """Approach: Sorted-list Hierholzer traversal
    Time: O(E log E)
    Space: O(E)
    """

    def findItinerary(self, tickets: list[list[str]]) -> list[str]:
        outgoing = defaultdict(list)
        for source, target in sorted(tickets, reverse=True):
            outgoing[source].append(target)
        stack = ["JFK"]
        reverse_route = []
        while stack:
            airport = stack[-1]
            if outgoing[airport]:
                stack.append(outgoing[airport].pop())
            else:
                reverse_route.append(stack.pop())
        return reverse_route[::-1]

items.title: 2. 堆積鄰接表的 Hierholzer 遍歷
items.text:
時間： O(E log E)

空間： O(E)

from collections import defaultdict


class Solution:
    """Approach: Heap-adjacency Hierholzer traversal
    Time: O(E log E)
    Space: O(E)
    """

    def findItinerary(self, tickets: list[list[str]]) -> list[str]:
        from heapq import heappop, heappush

        outgoing = {}
        for source, target in tickets:
            heappush(outgoing.setdefault(source, []), target)
        stack, route = ["JFK"], []
        while stack:
            edges = outgoing.get(stack[-1])
            if edges:
                stack.append(heappop(edges))
            else:
                route.append(stack.pop())
        route.reverse()
        return route

items.title: 1. 選取與略過狀態配對
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Take and skip state pairs
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def rob(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> int:
        values = {None: (0, 0)}
        stack = [(root, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, expanded = stack.pop()
            if expanded:
                left, right = values[node.left], values[node.right]
                values[node] = (node.val + left[1] + right[1], max(left) + max(right))
            else:
                stack.append((node, True))
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        stack.append((child, False))
        return max(values[root])

items.title: 2. 以孫節點遞推最佳值
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Best value with grandchild recurrence
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def rob(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> int:
        best = {None: 0}
        stack = [(root, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, expanded = stack.pop()
            if expanded:
                take = node.val
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        take += best[child.left] + best[child.right]
                best[node] = max(take, best[node.left] + best[node.right])
            else:
                stack.append((node, True))
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        stack.append((child, False))
        return best[root]

items.title: 1. 子迭代器的延遲堆疊
items.text:
時間： O(T) 總走訪; O(1) next 在 hasNext 之後

空間： O(depth)

class NestedInteger:
    """Standalone value container implementing the supplied nested-list interface."""

    def __init__(self, value=None):
        self._integer = value if isinstance(value, int) else None
        self._list = None if isinstance(value, int) else list(value or [])

    def isInteger(self):
        return self._integer is not None

    def getInteger(self):
        return self._integer

    def getList(self):
        return self._list

    def add(self, value):
        self._list.append(value)


class NestedIterator:
    """Approach: Lazy stack of child iterators
    Time: O(T) total traversal; O(1) next after hasNext
    Space: O(depth)
    """

    def __init__(self, nestedList: list["NestedInteger"]):
        self.stack = [iter(nestedList)]
        self.pending = None

    def hasNext(self) -> bool:
        if self.pending is not None:
            return True
        while self.stack:
            try:
                value = next(self.stack[-1])
            except StopIteration:
                self.stack.pop()
                continue
            if value.isInteger():
                self.pending = value.getInteger()
                return True
            self.stack.append(iter(value.getList()))
        return False

    def next(self) -> int:
        if not self.hasNext():
            raise StopIteration
        value, self.pending = self.pending, None
        return value

        self._list = None if isinstance(value, int) else list(value or [])

    def isInteger(self):
        return self._integer is not None

    def getInteger(self):
        return self._integer

    def getList(self):
        return self._list

    def add(self, value):
        self._list.append(value)


class NestedIterator:
    """Approach: Eager flattened snapshot
    Time: O(T) constructor; O(1) next/hasNext
    Space: O(T)
    """

    def __init__(self, nestedList: list["NestedInteger"]):
        self.values = []
        self.index = 0
        stack = list(reversed(nestedList))
        while stack:
            value = stack.pop()
            if value.isInteger():
                self.values.append(value.getInteger())
            else:
                stack.extend(reversed(value.getList()))

    def hasNext(self) -> bool:
        return self.index < len(self.values)

    def next(self) -> int:
        value = self.values[self.index]
        self.index += 1
        return value

items.title: 依總和計算最佳乘積
items.text: 每個總和試第一段，餘數可保持一段或取其最佳拆分。外層一定先切一段，因此至少得到兩段。

items.title: 優先因子三並調整餘數
items.text: 盡量拆成三，但最後的 3+1 改成 2+2。n=2、3 須另外處理，因為題目要求確實拆分。

items.title: 依總和計算最佳乘積
items.text: 每個拆分都有第一段，其餘不是單段就是另一個拆分。試遍第一段值就涵蓋每個合法拆分。

items.title: 優先因子三並調整餘數
items.text: 任何至少為五的整段，改成三與餘數可改善乘積。一會降低乘積，三個二又可改善成兩個三。因此最優形式只含三和至多兩個二。

items.title: 1. 依總和計算最佳乘積
items.text:
時間： O(n^2)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Best product by total
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def integerBreak(self, n: int) -> int:
        dp = [0] * (n + 1)
        for total in range(2, n + 1):
            dp[total] = max(
                first * max(total - first, dp[total - first]) for first in range(1, total)
            )
        return dp[n]

items.title: 2. 優先因子三並調整餘數
items.text:
時間： O(log n) 次算術運算

空間： O(1) 個整數物件

class Solution:
    """Approach: Factors of three with a remainder adjustment
    Time: O(log n) arithmetic operations
    Space: O(1) integer objects
    """

    def integerBreak(self, n: int) -> int:
        if n <= 3:
            return n - 1
        threes, remainder = divmod(n, 3)
        if remainder == 1:
            return 3 ** (threes - 1) * 4
        return 3**threes * (2 if remainder else 1)

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Frequency buckets
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def topKFrequent(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        frequencies = Counter(nums)
        buckets = [[] for _ in range(len(nums) + 1)]
        for number, count in frequencies.items():
            buckets[count].append(number)
        result = []
        for count in range(len(nums), 0, -1):
            for number in buckets[count]:
                result.append(number)
                if len(result) == k:
                    return result
        raise ValueError("k must not exceed the distinct value count")

from collections import Counter
from heapq import heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Size-k frequency heap
    Time: O(n + u log(k+1)); worst misses linear follow-up
    Space: O(u+k)
    """

    def topKFrequent(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        heap = []
        for value, count in Counter(nums).items():
            heappush(heap, (count, value))
            if len(heap) > k:
                heappop(heap)
        return [value for _, value in heap]

items.text:
時間： O(k) 新增; O(k) 讀取

空間： O(k)

from bisect import bisect_left


class SummaryRanges:
    """Approach: Sorted interval insertion and neighbor merging
    Time: O(k) add; O(k) get
    Space: O(k)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.intervals = []

    def addNum(self, value: int) -> None:
        index = bisect_left(self.intervals, [value])
        start = end = value
        if index and self.intervals[index - 1][1] + 1 >= value:
            index -= 1
            start, end = self.intervals.pop(index)
            end = max(end, value)
        while index < len(self.intervals) and self.intervals[index][0] <= end + 1:
            following = self.intervals.pop(index)
            end = max(end, following[1])
        self.intervals.insert(index, [start, end])

    def getIntervals(self) -> list[list[int]]:
        return [interval[:] for interval in self.intervals]

from bisect import bisect_left


class SummaryRanges:
    """Approach: Distinct-value set with read-time compression
    Time: O(1) expected add; O(u log u) get
    Space: O(u)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.values = set()

    def addNum(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.values.add(value)

    def getIntervals(self) -> list[list[int]]:
        answer = []
        for value in sorted(self.values):
            if answer and value == answer[-1][1] + 1:
                answer[-1][1] = value
            else:
                answer.append([value, value])
        return answer

items.title: 1. 寬排序與高度 LIS
items.text:
時間： O(n log n)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Width sort and height LIS
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxEnvelopes(self, envelopes: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        from bisect import bisect_left

        ordered = sorted(envelopes, key=lambda pair: (pair[0], -pair[1]))
        tails = []
        for _, height in ordered:
            position = bisect_left(tails, height)
            if position == len(tails):
                tails.append(height)
            else:
                tails[position] = height
        return len(tails)

items.title: 2. 全部前驅的套疊 DP
items.text:
時間： O(n^2)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: All-predecessor nesting DP
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def maxEnvelopes(self, envelopes: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        ordered = sorted(envelopes)
        dp = [1] * len(ordered)
        for i, (width, height) in enumerate(ordered):
            for j in range(i):
                if ordered[j][0] < width and ordered[j][1] < height:
                    dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1)
        return max(dp)

items.text: 每個使用者的串列附加帶時間戳的貼文。將本人及每個追蹤對象的最新貼文加入堆積，每次取出最新一則後，推進同一使用者的串流。

items.title: 掃描全域時間軸
items.text: 維護只附加、不刪改的全域貼文串列。由後往前掃描，只保留本人或目前追蹤對象的貼文，找到十則即停止。

items.title: 使用者時間軸的堆積合併
items.text: 每個堆積項目是某條合格時間軸中最新的尚未輸出貼文。其最大時間戳就是所有可見貼文中最新的一則，重複最多十次便得到所需消息。

items.title: 掃描全域時間軸
items.text: 附加順序的反向就是由新到舊的時間順序。按目前可見性篩選不改變該順序，所以前十則保留貼文恰好是答案。

items.title: 範例推演
items.text: 使用者 1 發出貼文 10，使用者 2 發出貼文 20，之後 1 追蹤 2。使用者 1 的消息為 [20,10]；取消追蹤 2 後變成 [10]。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text: 兩者發文、追蹤、取消追蹤皆為期望 O(1)。堆積法取得消息需 O(f+10 log(f+1)) 時間、O(f) 查詢空間，儲存為 O(T+F)；全域掃描法取得消息最壞 O(T) 時間，儲存為 O(T+F)。f 是目前追蹤對象數，T 是總貼文數，F 是總追蹤關係數。物件擁有自身狀態，查詢不修改呼叫端資料。使用者始終看得到自己的貼文，即使曾取消追蹤自己；追蹤集合會消除重複關係。

items.title: 1. 使用者時間軸的堆積合併
items.text:
時間： O(1) 發文／追蹤／取消追蹤 期望; O(f + 10 log(f+1)) 取得動態消息

空間： O(T+F) 儲存; O(f) 查詢

from collections import defaultdict
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Twitter:
    """Approach: Heap merge of user timelines
    Time: O(1) post/follow/unfollow expected; O(f + 10 log(f+1)) feed
    Space: O(T+F) stored; O(f) query
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.clock = 0
        self.posts = defaultdict(list)
        self.following = defaultdict(set)

    def postTweet(self, userId: int, tweetId: int) -> None:
        self.posts[userId].append((self.clock, tweetId))
        self.clock += 1

    def getNewsFeed(self, userId: int) -> list[int]:
        heap = []
        for user in self.following.get(userId, set()) | {userId}:
            posts = self.posts.get(user)
            if posts:
                index = len(posts) - 1
                heap.append((-posts[index][0], user, index))
        heapify(heap)
        result = []
        while heap and len(result) < 10:
            _, user, index = heappop(heap)
            result.append(self.posts[user][index][1])
            if index:
                heappush(heap, (-self.posts[user][index - 1][0], user, index - 1))
        return result

    def follow(self, followerId: int, followeeId: int) -> None:
        self.following[followerId].add(followeeId)

    def unfollow(self, followerId: int, followeeId: int) -> None:
        followees = self.following.get(followerId)
        if followees is not None:
            followees.discard(followeeId)
            if not followees:
                del self.following[followerId]

items.title: 2. 掃描全域時間軸
items.text:
時間： O(1) 發文／追蹤／取消追蹤 期望; O(T) 取得動態消息

空間： O(T+F)

from collections import defaultdict
from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Twitter:
    """Approach: Scan global timeline
    Time: O(1) post/follow/unfollow expected; O(T) feed
    Space: O(T+F)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.timeline = []
        self.following = defaultdict(set)

    def postTweet(self, userId: int, tweetId: int) -> None:
        self.timeline.append((userId, tweetId))

    def getNewsFeed(self, userId: int) -> list[int]:
        visible = self.following.get(userId, set()) | {userId}
        result = []
        for user, tweet in reversed(self.timeline):
            if user in visible:
                result.append(tweet)
                if len(result) == 10:
                    break
        return result

    def follow(self, followerId: int, followeeId: int) -> None:
        self.following[followerId].add(followeeId)

    def unfollow(self, followerId: int, followeeId: int) -> None:
        followees = self.following.get(followerId)
        if followees is not None:
            followees.discard(followeeId)
            if not followees:
                del self.following[followerId]

class Solution:
    """Approach: Count by significant length
    Time: O(min(n,10))
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def countNumbersWithUniqueDigits(self, n: int) -> int:
        answer = 1
        ways = 9
        for length in range(1, min(n, 10) + 1):
            if length > 1:
                ways *= 11 - length
            answer += ways
        return answer

items.title: 2. 數位遮罩 DP 與前導填補
items.text:
時間： O(n102^10)

空間： O(2^10)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Digit-mask DP with leading padding
    Time: O(n*10*2^10)
    Space: O(2^10)
    """

    def countNumbersWithUniqueDigits(self, n: int) -> int:
        counts = {(0, False): 1}
        for _ in range(n):
            following = {}
            for (mask, started), count in counts.items():
                for digit in range(10):
                    if not started and digit == 0:
                        state = (0, False)
                    elif mask & (1 << digit):
                        continue
                    else:
                        state = (mask | (1 << digit), True)
                    following[state] = following.get(state, 0) + count
            counts = following
        return sum(counts.values())

items.title: 1. 長度與前驅連結
items.text:
時間： O(n^2)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Lengths and predecessor links
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def largestDivisibleSubset(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        ordered = sorted(nums)
        lengths, previous = [1] * len(nums), [-1] * len(nums)
        best = 0
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            for j in range(i):
                if ordered[i] % ordered[j] == 0 and lengths[j] + 1 > lengths[i]:
                    lengths[i], previous[i] = lengths[j] + 1, j
            if lengths[i] > lengths[best]:
                best = i
        result = []
        while best >= 0:
            result.append(ordered[best])
            best = previous[best]
        return result[::-1]

items.title: 2. 明確保留各端點最佳鏈
items.text:
時間： O(n^2)

空間： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit best chains by endpoint
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def largestDivisibleSubset(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        ordered = sorted(nums)
        chains = []
        for i, value in enumerate(ordered):
            best = []
            for j in range(i):
                if value % ordered[j] == 0 and len(chains[j]) > len(best):
                    best = chains[j]
            chains.append(best + [value])
        return max(chains, key=len)

items.text: 在 32 位元遮罩下，反覆求 XOR 部分和與左移的 AND 進位，最後解讀符號位。

items.title: 1. 平行進位傳播
items.text:
時間： O(W) 最差情況

空間： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Parallel carry propagation
    Time: O(W) worst case
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def getSum(self, a: int, b: int) -> int:
        mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
        a &= mask
        b &= mask
        while b:
            a, b = (a ^ b) & mask, ((a & b) << 1) & mask
        return a if a <= 0x7FFFFFFF else ~(a ^ mask)

items.title: 2. 逐位全加器
items.text:
時間： O(W)

空間： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bit-by-bit full adder
    Time: O(W)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def getSum(self, a: int, b: int) -> int:
        answer = carry = 0
        for bit in range(32):
            x, y = (a >> bit) & 1, (b >> bit) & 1
            answer |= (x ^ y ^ carry) << bit
            carry = (x & y) | (x & carry) | (y & carry)
        return answer if answer <= 0x7FFFFFFF else ~(answer ^ 0xFFFFFFFF)

items.title: 1. 配對和排序列的堆積合併
items.text:
時間： O(min(k,m) + k log(min(k,m)+1))

空間： O(min(k,m)) 輔助 另加輸出

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Heap merge of sum rows
    Time: O(min(k,m) + k log(min(k,m)+1))
    Space: O(min(k,m)) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def kSmallestPairs(self, nums1: list[int], nums2: list[int], k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        if not nums1 or not nums2:
            return []
        heap = [(nums1[i] + nums2[0], i, 0) for i in range(min(k, len(nums1)))]
        heapify(heap)
        result = []
        while heap and len(result) < k:
            _, i, j = heappop(heap)
            result.append([nums1[i], nums2[j]])
            if j + 1 < len(nums2):
                heappush(heap, (nums1[i] + nums2[j + 1], i, j + 1))
        return result

items.title: 2. 二維最佳優先搜尋前緣
items.text:
時間： O(k log(k+1))

空間： O(k) 輔助 另加輸出

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Two-dimensional best-first frontier
    Time: O(k log(k+1))
    Space: O(k) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def kSmallestPairs(self, nums1: list[int], nums2: list[int], k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        if not nums1 or not nums2:
            return []
        heap = [(nums1[0] + nums2[0], 0, 0)]
        seen = {(0, 0)}
        result = []
        while heap and len(result) < k:
            _, i, j = heappop(heap)
            result.append([nums1[i], nums2[j]])
            for row, col in ((i + 1, j), (i, j + 1)):
                if row < len(nums1) and col < len(nums2) and (row, col) not in seen:
                    seen.add((row, col))
                    heappush(heap, (nums1[row] + nums2[col], row, col))
        return result

items.text: 比較相鄰值。上升可將最佳下降結尾長度加一；下降則將最佳上升結尾長度加一。

items.title: 逐索引交替子序列 DP

items.text: 在同方向區段內保留更極端的端點，至少能為未來反轉留下同樣空間。只有方向改變時才需要延長所選子序列，兩個狀態正好計算此事。

items.title: 逐索引交替子序列 DP
items.text: 每個非單元素擺動都有倒數第二索引，且該處的最後一步方向相反。列舉這些前驅狀態，即完整實現最佳子結構遞推。

items.title: 1. 壓縮的上升／下降貪婪狀態
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Compressed up/down greedy states
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def wiggleMaxLength(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        up = down = 1
        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            if nums[i] > nums[i - 1]:
                up = down + 1
            elif nums[i] < nums[i - 1]:
                down = up + 1
        return max(up, down)

items.title: 2. 逐索引交替子序列 DP
items.text:
時間： O(n squared)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Per-index alternating-subsequence DP
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def wiggleMaxLength(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        up = [1] * len(nums)
        down = [1] * len(nums)
        for i, value in enumerate(nums):
            for j in range(i):
                if nums[j] < value:
                    up[i] = max(up[i], down[j] + 1)
                elif nums[j] > value:
                    down[i] = max(down[i], up[j] + 1)
        return max(max(up), max(down))

items.text: 每個非空序列都有唯一最後值。移除它得較小總和序列，因此加總前驅恰將每個有序序列數一次。

items.title: 1. 最後元素金額 DP
items.text:
時間： O(n*T)

空間： O(T)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Final-element amount DP
    Time: O(n*T)
    Space: O(T)
    """

    def combinationSum4(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        dp = [0] * (target + 1)
        dp[0] = 1
        for total in range(1, target + 1):
            dp[total] = sum(dp[total - value] for value in nums if value <= total)
        return dp[target]

items.title: 2. 正向路徑傳播
items.text:
時間： O(n*T)

空間： O(T)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward path propagation
    Time: O(n*T)
    Space: O(T)
    """

    def combinationSum4(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
        ways = {0: 1}
        for total in range(target + 1):
            count = ways.get(total, 0)
            if not count:
                continue
            for value in nums:
                following = total + value
                if following <= target:
                    ways[following] = ways.get(following, 0) + count
        return ways.get(target, 0)

items.title: 1. 二分搜尋值域
items.text:
時間： O(n log(W+1))

空間： O(1)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search the value range
    Time: O(n log(W+1))
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def kthSmallest(self, matrix: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(matrix)
        low, high = matrix[0][0], matrix[-1][-1]
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            row, col, count = n - 1, 0, 0
            while row >= 0 and col < n:
                if matrix[row][col] <= middle:
                    count += row + 1
                    col += 1
                else:
                    row -= 1
            if count < k:
                low = middle + 1
            else:
                high = middle
        return low

items.text:
時間： O(n + k log(n+1))

空間： O(n)

from heapq import heapify, heappop, heappush


class Solution:
    """Approach: Heap merge sorted rows
    Time: O(n + k log(n+1))
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def kthSmallest(self, matrix: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
        heap = [(row[0], index, 0) for index, row in enumerate(matrix)]
        heapify(heap)
        for _ in range(k):
            value, row, col = heappop(heap)
            if col + 1 < len(matrix):
                heappush(heap, (matrix[row][col + 1], row, col + 1))
        return value

from random import choice


class RandomizedSet:
    """Approach: Dense array and index map
    Time: O(1) expected per operation
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.values = []
        self.indices = {}

    def insert(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val in self.indices:
            return False
        self.indices[val] = len(self.values)
        self.values.append(val)
        return True

    def remove(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val not in self.indices:
            return False
        index = self.indices[val]
        last = self.values[-1]
        self.values[index] = last
        self.indices[last] = index
        self.values.pop()
        del self.indices[val]
        return True

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        return choice(self.values)

from collections import defaultdict
from random import choice, randrange


class RandomizedCollection:
    """Approach: Dense occurrences and index sets
    Time: O(1) expected per operation
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.values = []
        self.positions = defaultdict(set)

    def insert(self, val: int) -> bool:
        absent = not self.positions[val]
        self.positions[val].add(len(self.values))
        self.values.append(val)
        return absent

    def remove(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val not in self.positions:
            return False
        index = self.positions[val].pop()
        last_index = len(self.values) - 1
        last = self.values[-1]
        if index != last_index:
            self.values[index] = last
            self.positions[last].remove(last_index)
            self.positions[last].add(index)
        self.values.pop()
        if not self.positions[val]:
            del self.positions[val]
        return True

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        return choice(self.values)

from collections import defaultdict
from random import choice, randrange


class RandomizedCollection:
    """Approach: Frequency map and weighted scan
    Time: O(1) expected insert/remove; O(u) getRandom; misses required O(1)
    Space: O(u)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.counts = {}
        self.total = 0

    def insert(self, val: int) -> bool:
        absent = val not in self.counts
        self.counts[val] = self.counts.get(val, 0) + 1
        self.total += 1
        return absent

    def remove(self, val: int) -> bool:
        if val not in self.counts:
            return False
        self.counts[val] -= 1
        self.total -= 1
        if self.counts[val] == 0:
            del self.counts[val]
        return True

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        index = randrange(self.total)
        for value, count in self.counts.items():
            if index < count:
                return value
            index -= count
        raise AssertionError("Unreachable for a nonempty collection")

時間： O(1) 建構; O(n) 讀取Random

空間： O(1)

from random import choice, randrange


class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Reservoir sampling
    Time: O(1) constructor; O(n) getRandom
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def __init__(self, head: ListNode):
        self.head = head

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        current = self.head
        count = 0
        selected = current.val
        while current:
            count += 1
            if randrange(count) == 0:
                selected = current.val
            current = current.next
        return selected

from random import choice, randrange


class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next


class Solution:
    """Approach: Value snapshot and random indexing
    Time: O(n) constructor; O(1) getRandom
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self, head: ListNode):
        self.values = []
        while head:
            self.values.append(head.val)
            head = head.next

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        return choice(self.values)

items.text:
時間： O(n) 建構/reset/shuffle

空間： O(n)

from random import randrange


class Solution:
    """Approach: Forward Fisher-Yates swaps
    Time: O(n) constructor/reset/shuffle
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self, nums: list[int]):
        self.original = tuple(nums)

    def reset(self) -> list[int]:
        return list(self.original)

    def shuffle(self) -> list[int]:
        result = list(self.original)
        for index in range(len(result)):
            chosen = randrange(index, len(result))
            result[index], result[chosen] = result[chosen], result[index]
        return result

items.text:
時間： O(n) 建構/reset/shuffle

空間： O(n)

from random import randrange


class Solution:
    """Approach: Inside-out permutation construction
    Time: O(n) constructor/reset/shuffle
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self, nums: list[int]):
        self.original = tuple(nums)

    def reset(self) -> list[int]:
        return list(self.original)

    def shuffle(self) -> list[int]:
        result = []
        for index, value in enumerate(self.original):
            chosen = randrange(index + 1)
            result.append(value)
            result[index] = result[chosen]
            result[chosen] = value
        return result

items.text:
時間： O(n+L*d) 最壞情況

空間： O(n+L*d) 最壞情況

class Solution:
    """Approach: Stack of suspended output chunks
    Time: O(n+L*d) worst case
    Space: O(n+L*d) worst case
    """

    def decodeString(self, s: str) -> str:
        stack = []
        chunks = []
        count = 0
        for char in s:
            if char.isdigit():
                count = count * 10 + int(char)
            elif char == "[":
                stack.append((chunks, count))
                chunks, count = [], 0
            elif char == "]":
                text = "".join(chunks)
                chunks, repetitions = stack.pop()
                chunks.append(text * repetitions)
            else:
                chunks.append(char)
        return "".join(chunks)

items.title: 2. 依括號範圍遞迴下降解析
items.text:
時間： O(n+L*d) 最壞情況

空間： O(n+L*d) 最壞情況

class Solution:
    """Approach: Recursive descent by bracket scope
    Time: O(n+L*d) worst case
    Space: O(n+L*d) worst case
    """

    def decodeString(self, s: str) -> str:
        index = 0

        def parse():
            nonlocal index
            pieces = []
            while index < len(s) and s[index] != "]":
                if s[index].isdigit():
                    count = 0
                    while s[index].isdigit():
                        count = count * 10 + int(s[index])
                        index += 1
                    index += 1
                    inner = parse()
                    index += 1
                    pieces.append(inner * count)
                else:
                    pieces.append(s[index])
                    index += 1
            return "".join(pieces)

        return parse()

時間： O(1) 建構; O(n) pick

空間： O(1)

from collections import defaultdict
from random import choice, randrange


class Solution:
    """Approach: Matching-index reservoir
    Time: O(1) constructor; O(n) pick
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def __init__(self, nums: list[int]):
        self.values = nums

    def pick(self, target: int) -> int:
        matches = 0
        selected = -1
        for index, value in enumerate(self.values):
            if value == target:
                matches += 1
                if randrange(matches) == 0:
                    selected = index
        return selected

from collections import defaultdict
from random import choice, randrange


class Solution:
    """Approach: Target-to-indices map
    Time: O(n) constructor; O(1) expected pick
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def __init__(self, nums: list[int]):
        self.indices = defaultdict(list)
        for index, value in enumerate(nums):
            self.indices[value].append(index)

    def pick(self, target: int) -> int:
        return choice(self.indices[target])

items.title: 比例乘積圖搜尋
items.text: 每個等式加入一條比例邊及其倒數邊。對每個查詢，從起點搜尋，沿路累乘邊權重；到達終點時，乘積就是所求比例。

items.title: 帶比例權重的並查集
items.text: 保存變數與父節點的比例，並以集合大小決定分量根的合併方向。迭代壓縮路徑時，同時累乘比例；加入新等式時，推導連接兩個根所需的權重，讓等式仍成立。

items.title: 比例乘積圖搜尋
items.text: 路徑上的中間變數會在乘積中相消，只留下起點與終點的比例。等式一致保證不同路徑得到相同結果；若找不到路徑，就無法由已知等式決定比例。

items.title: 帶比例權重的並查集
items.text: 不變量 weight[x]=x/parent[x] 使沿祖先鏈的乘積等於 x/root；路徑壓縮後仍保有這個比例。以推導出的比例連接兩個根，可保留每個等式。查詢兩個相連變數時，將它們相對於共同根的權重相除，即得到兩者比例。

items.title: 範例推演
items.text: 若 a/b=2、b/c=3，則 a/c=6、c/a=1/6。若 x 未出現在等式中，即使查詢 x/x，也應回傳 -1。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text: 令 V 為變數數量、E 為等式數量、Q 為查詢數量。圖搜尋為 O(E+Q*(V+E)) 時間、O(V+E) 空間；帶權並查集為期望 O((E+Q)*alpha(V)) 時間、O(V) 空間。輸入不變。未知變數的自身查詢，與已知變數的自身查詢不同。浮點乘積依題目容許誤差比較；倒數邊要求等式值為正且非零。

items.title: 1. 比例乘積圖搜尋
items.text:
時間： O(E+Q*(V+E))

空間： O(V+E)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Ratio-product graph search
    Time: O(E+Q*(V+E))
    Space: O(V+E)
    """

    def calcEquation(self, equations, values, queries):
        graph = {}
        for (a, b), value in zip(equations, values, strict=True):
            graph.setdefault(a, []).append((b, value))
            graph.setdefault(b, []).append((a, 1 / value))
        answers = []
        for start, end in queries:
            if start not in graph or end not in graph:
                answers.append(-1.0)
                continue
            stack, seen = [(start, 1.0)], {start}
            answer = -1.0
            while stack:
                node, ratio = stack.pop()
                if node == end:
                    answer = ratio
                    break
                for other, factor in graph[node]:
                    if other not in seen:
                        seen.add(other)
                        stack.append((other, ratio * factor))
            answers.append(answer)
        return answers

items.title: 2. 帶比例權重的並查集
items.text:
時間： O((E+Q)*alpha(V)) 期望

空間： O(V)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Weighted union-find ratios
    Time: O((E+Q)*alpha(V)) expected
    Space: O(V)
    """

    def calcEquation(self, equations, values, queries):
        parent, weight, size = {}, {}, {}

        def find(node):
            trail = []
            root = node
            while parent[root] != root:
                trail.append(root)
                root = parent[root]
            ratio = 1.0
            for item in reversed(trail):
                ratio *= weight[item]
                parent[item], weight[item] = root, ratio
            return root, weight[node]

        for (a, b), value in zip(equations, values, strict=True):
            for node in (a, b):
                if node not in parent:
                    parent[node], weight[node], size[node] = node, 1.0, 1
            ra, wa = find(a)
            rb, wb = find(b)
            if ra == rb:
                continue
            if size[ra] < size[rb]:
                parent[ra], weight[ra] = rb, value * wb / wa
                size[rb] += size[ra]
            else:
                parent[rb], weight[rb] = ra, wa / (value * wb)
                size[ra] += size[rb]
        answers = []
        for a, b in queries:
            if a not in parent or b not in parent:
                answers.append(-1.0)
                continue
            ra, wa = find(a)
            rb, wb = find(b)
            answers.append(wa / wb if ra == rb else -1.0)
        return answers

items.title: 1. 扣除完整位數區塊
items.text:
時間： O(log n)

空間： O(log n) 用於 十進位轉換

class Solution:
    """Approach: Subtract complete digit-width blocks
    Time: O(log n)
    Space: O(log n) for decimal conversion
    """

    def findNthDigit(self, n: int) -> int:
        width, start, count = 1, 1, 9
        while n > width * count:
            n -= width * count
            width += 1
            start *= 10
            count *= 10
        number = start + (n - 1) // width
        return int(str(number)[(n - 1) % width])

items.title: 2. 二分搜尋所在整數
items.text:
時間： O(log^2 n)

空間： O(log n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search containing integer
    Time: O(log squared n)
    Space: O(log n)
    """

    def findNthDigit(self, n: int) -> int:
        def digits_through(value):
            total, start, width = 0, 1, 1
            while start <= value:
                end = min(value, start * 10 - 1)
                total += (end - start + 1) * width
                start *= 10
                width += 1
            return total

        low, high = 1, n
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high) // 2
            if digits_through(middle) >= n:
                high = middle
            else:
                low = middle + 1
        offset = n - digits_through(low - 1) - 1
        return int(str(low)[offset])

items.title: 單調數字堆疊
items.text: 還有刪除額度時，彈出前面較大的數字。若最後仍有剩餘額度，就從尾端移除，再清除前導零。

items.title: 貪婪選擇下一個數字
items.text: 在剩餘刪除額度能到達的位置中，選最小可行數字作為下一個保留項目。長遞減輸入可能讓此教學基準逾時。

items.title: 單調數字堆疊
items.text: 第一個「前大後小」配對中，刪掉前面的較大位數，比在該前綴更後面刪除更能降低數值。反覆套用此交換，就得到字典序最小的保留序列。

items.title: 貪婪選擇下一個數字
items.text: 下一個保留數字必須位於刪除預算可及的位置。選擇最早的最小候選，能最小化第一個尚未確定的輸出位置，同時保留最多後續選擇。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text:
單調堆疊：O(n) 時間、O(n) 空間。逐位貪婪選擇：O(n²) 時間、O(n) 空間，長輸入可能較慢。

輸入不變。不必刪除相等數字。k=0 時不可使用 stack[:-k]，因為 -0 就是 0，會切出空前綴。

items.title: 1. 單調數字堆疊
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Monotonic digit stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def removeKdigits(self, num: str, k: int) -> str:
        stack = []
        for char in num:
            while k and stack and stack[-1] > char:
                stack.pop()
                k -= 1
            stack.append(char)
        if k:
            del stack[-k:]
        return "".join(stack).lstrip("0") or "0"

items.title: 2. 貪婪選擇下一個數字
items.text:
時間： O(n²)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Greedy next-digit selection
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def removeKdigits(self, num: str, k: int) -> str:
        keep = len(num) - k
        start = 0
        answer = []
        while keep:
            end = len(num) - keep
            index = min(range(start, end + 1), key=num.__getitem__)
            answer.append(num[index])
            start = index + 1
            keep -= 1
        return "".join(answer).lstrip("0") or "0"

items.title: 依石頭位置的稀疏跳長集合
items.text: 為每個石頭位置保存可達末跳長。位置零以長零開始，強制首個正選擇為一，且只向存在的石頭傳播。

items.text: 對每對較早石頭，將距離當必要抵達跳長；若前石支援小一、相同或大一的末跳，就可抵達。

items.title: 依石頭位置的稀疏跳長集合
items.text: 每個傳播狀態都在既有合法路線後接一個允許跳躍。反之，每條路線都從較早石頭經三種前驅跳長轉移之一抵達，按位置遞增掃描必能發現。

items.title: 稠密抵達索引與末跳表
items.text: 造訪至多 n 石後，跳長不會超過 n，因為從一開始且每次最多加一。所以有界跳長維度涵蓋全部路線，前驅遞推也精確檢查合法最後轉移。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text:
依石頭位置的稀疏跳長集合：時間 O(n^2)，期望值；空間 O(n^2)。 稠密抵達索引與末跳表：時間 O(n^2)；空間 O(n^2)。

兩法保留 stones。稀疏集合可避免許多不可能跳長；稠密表保證平方掃描，但配置 n*(n+1) 個參照。兩者無遞迴，對 n=2000 很重要。位置嚴格遞增，所以沒有狀態會更新自己的集合。

items.text: 每個程式區塊都能獨立使用，並採用 LeetCode 的類別名稱。選一個貼入 Python3 編輯器；需要時已附共用節點定義。兩種語言共用完全相同的程式。

items.title: 1. 依石頭位置的稀疏跳長集合
items.text:
時間： O(n^2)，期望值

空間： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sparse jump-length sets by stone position
    Time: O(n^2) expected
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def canCross(self, stones: list[int]) -> bool:
        jumps = {position: set() for position in stones}
        jumps[0].add(0)
        for position in stones:
            for previous in jumps[position]:
                for following in (previous - 1, previous, previous + 1):
                    target = position + following
                    if following > 0 and target in jumps:
                        jumps[target].add(following)
        return bool(jumps[stones[-1]])

items.title: 2. 稠密抵達索引與末跳表
items.text:
時間： O(n^2)

空間： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Dense arrival-index and last-jump table
    Time: O(n^2)
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def canCross(self, stones: list[int]) -> bool:
        n = len(stones)
        dp = [[False] * (n + 1) for _ in stones]
        dp[0][0] = True
        for end in range(1, n):
            for previous in range(end):
                jump = stones[end] - stones[previous]
                if jump > n:
                    continue
                dp[end][jump] = (
                    dp[end][jump]
                    or dp[previous][jump - 1]
                    or dp[previous][jump]
                    or (jump < n and dp[previous][jump + 1])
                )
        return any(dp[-1])

items.text: 依身高遞增，同身高則依 k 遞減處理。以記錄可用位置的 Fenwick 樹，將每人放入第 k+1 個空位。

items.text: 插入時，已放的人都至少同樣高，因此索引 k 恰提供 k 個合格前人。之後較矮的插入不影響計數；相同身高的處理順序也能保持它。

items.title: 1. 身高遞減與串列插入
items.text:
時間： O(n squared)

空間： O(n) 輔助空間，另加輸出

class Solution:
    """Approach: Descending heights and list insertion
    Time: O(n squared)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def reconstructQueue(self, people: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        queue = []
        for height, count in sorted(people, key=lambda person: (-person[0], person[1])):
            queue.insert(count, [height, count])
        return queue

items.title: 2. 身高遞增與 Fenwick 空位選取
items.text:
時間： O(n log n)

空間： O(n) 輔助空間，另加輸出

class Solution:
    """Approach: Ascending heights and Fenwick free-slot selection
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n) auxiliary plus output
    """

    def reconstructQueue(self, people: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        size = len(people)
        bit = [0] + [i & -i for i in range(1, size + 1)]
        queue = [None] * size
        for height, count in sorted(people, key=lambda person: (person[0], -person[1])):
            rank = count + 1
            index = 0
            step = 1 << (size.bit_length() - 1)
            while step:
                following = index + step
                if following <= size and bit[following] < rank:
                    rank -= bit[following]
                    index = following
                step >>= 1
            queue[index] = [height, count]
            update = index + 1
            while update <= size:
                bit[update] -= 1
                update += update & -update
        return queue

items.title: 二分搜尋可行最大區段和
items.text: 搜尋範圍從最大元素到整體總和。貪婪延伸每段，直到加入下一值會超過候選限制時才切段。

items.title: 精確段數動態規劃
items.text: 對每個段數，嘗試所有合法的最後一段起點，計算各前綴的最佳最大區段和。此教學基準在完整限制下可能逾時。

items.title: 二分搜尋可行最大區段和
items.text: 固定限制時，盡量晚切不會比提早切使用更多段。可行性隨限制單調；至多 k 段的分割可細分為恰 k 段，因為元素非負且 k<=n。

items.title: 精確段數動態規劃
items.text: 前綴的每個 c 段分割，皆由一個最佳 c-1 段前綴與最後的非空區間組成。對每個切點取兩者成本的較大值，再最小化，恰列舉全部合法分割。

items.text:
二分搜尋可行最大區段和：時間 O(n log(S+1))；空間 O(1)。 精確段數動態規劃：時間 O(k*n squared)；空間 O(n)。

輸入不變；S 為總和。允許零值，分割既有區段不會增加其總和。精確 k 段的 DP 狀態，必須為各非空段保留足夠元素。

items.title: Python 實作
items.text: 每個程式區塊都能獨立使用，並採用 LeetCode 的類別名稱。選一個貼入 Python3 編輯器；需要時已附共用節點定義。兩種語言共用完全相同的程式。

items.title: 1. 二分搜尋可行最大區段和
items.text:
時間： O(n log(S+1))

空間： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search a feasible maximum sum
    Time: O(n log(S+1))
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def splitArray(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        low, high = max(nums), sum(nums)
        while low < high:
            limit = (low + high) // 2
            pieces, total = 1, 0
            for value in nums:
                if total + value > limit:
                    pieces += 1
                    total = 0
                total += value
            if pieces <= k:
                high = limit
            else:
                low = limit + 1
        return low

items.title: 2. 精確段數動態規劃
items.text:
時間： O(k*n squared)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Exact-piece dynamic programming
    Time: O(k*n squared)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def splitArray(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        prefix = [0]
        for value in nums:
            prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
        previous = [0] + [float("inf")] * len(nums)
        for pieces in range(1, k + 1):
            current = [float("inf")] * (len(nums) + 1)
            for end in range(pieces, len(nums) + 1):
                current[end] = min(
                    max(previous[start], prefix[end] - prefix[start])
                    for start in range(pieces - 1, end)
                )
            previous = current
        return int(previous[-1])

兩法不改變 nums，自然處理長度小於三，且不配置差值串列或切片。相等值的差為零，也能形成合法等差切片。

items.title: Python 實作
items.text: 每個程式區塊都能獨立使用，並採用 LeetCode 的類別名稱。選一個貼入 Python3 編輯器；需要時已附共用節點定義。兩種語言共用完全相同的程式。

items.title: 1. 目前終點的等差後綴計數
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Count arithmetic suffixes ending here
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        ending = answer = 0
        for index in range(2, len(nums)):
            ending = (
                ending + 1
                if nums[index] - nums[index - 1] == nums[index - 1] - nums[index - 2]
                else 0
            )
            answer += ending
        return answer

items.title: 2. 加總最長同差區段
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(1)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Sum maximal equal-difference runs
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        answer = run = 0
        previous = None
        for index in range(1, len(nums)):
            difference = nums[index] - nums[index - 1]
            if difference != previous:
                answer += run * (run - 1) // 2
                run = 0
            run += 1
            previous = difference
        return answer + run * (run - 1) // 2

items.title: 位元集合的子集可達性
items.text: 第 k 位元代表可達總和 k。左移目前值會把它加到所有舊子集，再與略過它的狀態做 OR，並遮掉超過目標的位元。

items.title: 明確儲存可達總和集合
items.text: 以集合元素表示可達總和，每個值先建立獨立的新總和集合，再合併回去。

items.title: 位元集合的子集可達性
items.text: 聯集涵蓋選取與略過目前值的兩類子集。位移讀取舊整數，因此每個輸入位置只使用一次。

items.title: 明確儲存可達總和集合
items.text: 分開建立集合，避免同一位置被反覆使用。因輸入皆正，超過目標的總和後續不可能降低，可以捨棄。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text:
位元集合的子集可達性：時間 O(n*T/w) 個機器字的運算；空間 O(T/w) machine 個機器字。

明確儲存可達總和集合：時間 O(n*T) 期望；空間 O(T)。

T 是總和的一半，w 是整數機器字寬度。Python 大整數位移要處理多個機器字，不是 O(1)。兩法皆保留輸入；明確集合可能耗用遠多的記憶體。

items.title: 1. 位元集合的子集可達性
items.text:
時間： O(n*T/w) 個機器字的運算

空間： O(T/w) machine 個機器字

class Solution:
    """Approach: Bitset subset reachability
    Time: O(n*T/w) machine-word work
    Space: O(T/w) machine words
    """

    def canPartition(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        total = sum(nums)
        if total % 2:
            return False
        target = total // 2
        bits = 1
        mask = (1 << (target + 1)) - 1
        for value in nums:
            bits = (bits | (bits << value)) & mask
        return bool(bits & (1 << target))

items.title: 2. 明確儲存可達總和集合
items.text:
時間： O(n*T) 期望

空間： O(T)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit set of achievable sums
    Time: O(n*T) expected
    Space: O(T)
    """

    def canPartition(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        total = sum(nums)
        if total % 2:
            return False
        target = total // 2
        reachable = {0}
        for value in nums:
            following = {previous + value for previous in reachable if previous + value <= target}
            reachable.update(following)
        return target in reachable

items.title: 題目
items.text: 回傳水能同時流到兩個海洋的格子。太平洋接觸上邊界及左邊界，大西洋接觸下邊界及右邊界。水只能上下左右流向高度相同或較低的格子。

items.title: 提示
items.text:
1. 從每格各自向下搜尋，會重複大量工作。
  2. 反轉方向：從各海洋出發，只往較高或等高處移動。
展開解法、複雜度比較、證明與 Python 程式

items.title: 解法比較
items.text:
解法 時間 空間 兩次逆向水流 DFS O(R*C) O(R*C) 合併海洋標籤傳播 O(R*C) O(R*C)

請先閱讀各解法的限制與輸入修改說明。教學基準解法可能超過題目要求的成本上限；第一種為預設實作。

items.title: 兩次逆向水流 DFS
items.text: 分別以兩個海洋的邊界格子為起點，進行迭代走訪。逆向水流只可抵達高度大於等於目前格子的鄰居。各次走訪記錄自己的可達集合，最後依列順序回傳交集。

items.title: 合併海洋標籤傳播
items.text: 使用一個佇列，攜帶新得知的太平洋或大西洋位元標籤。先標記邊界格子，再將各海洋位元傳給等高或更高的鄰居，最後回傳同時具備兩個位元的格子。

items.title: 兩次逆向水流 DFS
items.text: 反轉邊後，原本向下流到海洋的路徑，會變成從海洋向上走的路徑。因此各次走訪恰好找到能流到該海洋的所有格子。屬於兩個集合的格子，各有一條到達對應海洋的路徑；兩條路徑不必相同。

items.title: 合併海洋標籤傳播
items.text: 逆向路徑精確代表往海洋的下坡路徑。每個格子的每個海洋位元只傳播一次，最終固定狀態恰好包含所有可達海洋標籤。遮罩值為三，就表示兩條海洋路徑都存在。

items.title: 範例推演
items.text: 對 [[1,2],[4,3]]，逆向太平洋水流透過 1->2->3 與 1->4 抵達四格。逆向大西洋水流無法往下抵達高度 1。能同時流到兩洋的格子為 [0,1]、[1,0]、[1,1]。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text:
預設兩次逆向 DFS 的時間與輔助空間皆為 O(rows * cols)，包含結果。高度不變。逆向走訪必須允許等高鄰居；若從海洋出發卻仍使用原本的下坡比較，會算出錯誤的可達集合。

兩次逆向水流 DFS 與合併海洋標籤傳播的時間皆為 O(RC)，空間皆為 O(RC)。合併版用一個小整數遮罩網格，取代兩個座標集合。兩法都以迭代實作、保留高度，也都必須允許通過等高邊。

items.title: Python 實作
items.text: 每個程式區塊都能獨立使用，並採用 LeetCode 的類別名稱。選一個貼入 Python3 編輯器；需要時已附共用節點定義。兩種語言共用完全相同的程式。

items.title: 1. 兩次逆向水流 DFS
items.text:
時間： O(R*C)

空間： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Two reversed-flow DFS traversals
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def pacificAtlantic(self, heights: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        rows, cols = len(heights), len(heights[0])

        def reach(starts):
            visited = set(starts)
            stack = list(visited)
            while stack:
                row, col = stack.pop()
                for nr, nc in ((row + 1, col), (row - 1, col), (row, col + 1), (row, col - 1)):
                    if (
                        0 <= nr < rows
                        and 0 <= nc < cols
                        and heights[nr][nc] >= heights[row][col]
                        and (nr, nc) not in visited
                    ):
                        visited.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            return visited

        pacific = reach([(0, col) for col in range(cols)] + [(row, 0) for row in range(rows)])
        atlantic = reach(
            [(rows - 1, col) for col in range(cols)] + [(row, cols - 1) for row in range(rows)]
        )
        return [
            [row, col]
            for row in range(rows)
            for col in range(cols)
            if (row, col) in pacific and (row, col) in atlantic
        ]

items.title: 2. 合併海洋標籤傳播
items.text:
時間： O(R*C)

空間： O(R*C)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Fused ocean-label propagation
    Time: O(R*C)
    Space: O(R*C)
    """

    def pacificAtlantic(self, heights: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
        from collections import deque

        rows, columns = len(heights), len(heights[0])
        masks = [[0] * columns for _ in range(rows)]
        queue = deque()

        def add(row, column, bit):
            if not masks[row][column] & bit:
                masks[row][column] |= bit
                queue.append((row, column, bit))

        for row in range(rows):
            add(row, 0, 1)
            add(row, columns - 1, 2)
        for column in range(columns):
            add(0, column, 1)
            add(rows - 1, column, 2)
        while queue:
            row, column, bit = queue.popleft()
            for nr, nc in (
                (row - 1, column),
                (row + 1, column),
                (row, column - 1),
                (row, column + 1),
            ):
                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < columns and heights[nr][nc] >= heights[row][column]:
                    add(nr, nc, bit)
        return [[r, c] for r in range(rows) for c in range(columns) if masks[r][c] == 3]

items.title: 1. 維護精確次數的視窗
items.text:
時間： O(26n)

空間： O(26)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Exact-frequency window
    Time: O(26n)
    Space: O(26)
    """

    def characterReplacement(self, s: str, k: int) -> int:
        counts = [0] * 26
        left = best = 0
        for right, char in enumerate(s):
            counts[ord(char) - ord("A")] += 1
            while right - left + 1 - max(counts) > k:
                counts[ord(s[left]) - ord("A")] -= 1
                left += 1
            best = max(best, right - left + 1)
        return best

items.title: 2. 二分搜尋可行長度
items.text:
時間： O(26n log n)

空間： O(26)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Binary search a feasible length
    Time: O(26n log n)
    Space: O(26)
    """

    def characterReplacement(self, s: str, k: int) -> int:
        def feasible(width):
            counts = [0] * 26
            for right, char in enumerate(s):
                counts[ord(char) - ord("A")] += 1
                if right >= width:
                    counts[ord(s[right - width]) - ord("A")] -= 1
                if right >= width - 1 and width - max(counts) <= k:
                    return True
            return False

        low, high = 0, len(s)
        while low < high:
            middle = (low + high + 1) // 2
            if feasible(middle):
                low = middle
            else:
                high = middle - 1
        return low

items.title: 1. 明確保存延後 next 的堆疊
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： 最差 O(n)

class Node:
    def __init__(self, val=0, prev=None, next=None, child=None):
        self.val, self.prev, self.next, self.child = val, prev, next, child


class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit deferred-next stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n) worst
    """

    def flatten(self, head: "Node | None") -> "Node | None":
        stack = [head] if head else []
        previous = None
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            if node.next:
                stack.append(node.next)
            if node.child:
                stack.append(node.child)
            node.prev = previous
            if previous:
                previous.next = node
            node.child = None
            previous = node
        if previous:
            previous.next = None
        return head

items.title: 2. 原地插接 child 串列
items.text:
時間： O(n)，攤銷界限

空間： O(1)

class Node:
    def __init__(self, val=0, prev=None, next=None, child=None):
        self.val, self.prev, self.next, self.child = val, prev, next, child


class Solution:
    """Approach: Splice child lists in place
    Time: O(n) amortized
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def flatten(self, head: "Node | None") -> "Node | None":
        if head:
            head.prev = None
        current = head
        while current:
            if current.child:
                first = current.child
                last = first
                while last.next:
                    last = last.next
                last.next = current.next
                if current.next:
                    current.next.prev = last
                current.next = first
                first.prev = current
                current.child = None
            current = current.next
        return head

items.title: 保留最早結束的區間
items.text: 依終點排序。起點 >=上一個保留終點時就貪婪保留，最後用總數減保留數。

items.title: 依起點替換重疊候選
items.text: 依起點排序。遇到重疊就刪掉其中一段，保留較小終點；沒有重疊則更新保留終點。

items.title: 保留最早結束的區間
items.text: 可用且相容的選擇中，最早結束者留給未來的空間至少不比其他選擇少。用它替換最佳解第一個區間，不會減少後續能放的數量；重複套用此交換即可。

items.title: 依起點替換重疊候選
items.text: 重疊區間中保留較早終點，對每個未來區間都至少保留同樣多空間。因此替換掉較晚結束候選，仍能保持最佳保留數。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text:
兩者皆為 O(n log n) 時間；此 Python 實作的排序需要 O(n) 空間，輸入不變。

使用 start>=end，讓接觸端點的區間也能保留。若只依起點排序、永遠保留第一段，可能留下一個很長的區間，擋掉多個短區間；重疊時需要保留較小終點。

items.title: 1. 保留最早結束的區間
items.text:
時間： O(n log n)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Keep earliest finishing intervals
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def eraseOverlapIntervals(self, intervals: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        end = float("-inf")
        kept = 0
        for start, finish in sorted(intervals, key=lambda interval: interval[1]):
            if start >= end:
                kept += 1
                end = finish
        return len(intervals) - kept

items.title: 2. 依起點替換重疊候選
items.text:
時間： O(n log n)

空間： O(n)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Start-order overlap replacement
    Time: O(n log n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def eraseOverlapIntervals(self, intervals: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        end = float("-inf")
        removed = 0
        for start, finish in sorted(intervals):
            if start < end:
                removed += 1
                end = min(end, finish)
            else:
                end = finish
        return removed

items.text: 計算總和等於 targetSum 的向下路徑數量。起點與終點可以是任意節點，但每一步只能由父節點走向子節點。

items.title: 提示
items.text:
1. 目前前綴和減去某個祖先前綴和，就是兩者之間路徑的總和。
  2. 次數表只能包含目前祖先鏈的前綴，離開子樹時必須復原。

items.title: 解法比較
items.text:
解法 時間 空間 目前祖先路徑的前綴頻率 O(n) 期望 O(h) 列舉向下路徑起點 O(n*h), O(n^2) 最壞情況 O(h)

請先閱讀各解法的限制與輸入修改說明。教學基準解法可能超過題目要求的成本上限；第一種為預設實作。

items.title: 目前祖先路徑的前綴頻率
items.text: 用進入與離開框架進行迭代深度優先搜尋。進入節點得到目前前綴和後，先查詢 prefix-targetSum 的次數，再加入目前前綴。離開節點時減回該次數，避免下一個兄弟子樹使用這條路徑。

items.title: 列舉向下路徑起點
items.text: 把每個節點各當一次起點，再往下走訪所有後代並累加路徑和。這個基準法不需要前綴次數表，但會重複走過子樹。

items.title: 目前祖先路徑的前綴頻率
items.text: 次數表中的每個前綴都對應目前節點的一個合法祖先切點。兩個前綴的差等於向下路徑和，所以符合差值的次數恰好是以目前節點為終點的合法路徑數。離開時復原，便不會把不同兄弟子樹錯接成路徑。

items.title: 列舉向下路徑起點
items.text: 每條向下路徑有唯一的起點與終點。外層恰好選到其起點一次，內層也恰好走到其終點一次，因此每條符合總和的路徑計數一次。

items.title: 範例推演
items.text: 一條值為 [1,1,1] 的鏈，targetSum=2。有「上方到中間」與「中間到下方」兩條合法路徑，答案為 2。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text: 前綴法的期望時間為 O(n)，輔助空間為 O(h)。列舉法為 O(nh) 時間，最壞為 O(n²)，輔助空間 O(h)，長鏈上可能很慢。兩者都不修改樹。前綴表初始需有零的次數 1，才能計入從根開始的路徑；必須記錄頻率而非只記集合，因為零值與重複前綴會產生多條合法路徑。

items.title: 1. 目前祖先路徑的前綴頻率
items.text:
時間： O(n) 期望

空間： O(h)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Active prefix frequencies
    Time: O(n) expected
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def pathSum(self, root: TreeNode | None, targetSum: int) -> int:
        counts = {0: 1}
        result = 0
        stack = [(root, 0, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, prefix, exiting = stack.pop()
            if exiting:
                counts[prefix] -= 1
                if counts[prefix] == 0:
                    del counts[prefix]
                continue
            prefix += node.val
            result += counts.get(prefix - targetSum, 0)
            counts[prefix] = counts.get(prefix, 0) + 1
            stack.append((node, prefix, True))
            if node.right:
                stack.append((node.right, prefix, False))
            if node.left:
                stack.append((node.left, prefix, False))
        return result

items.title: 2. 列舉向下路徑起點
items.text:
時間： O(n*h), O(n^2) 最壞情況

空間： O(h)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Enumerate downward starts
    Time: O(n*h), O(n^2) worst
    Space: O(h)
    """

    def pathSum(self, root: TreeNode | None, targetSum: int) -> int:
        result = 0
        starts = [root] if root else []
        while starts:
            start = starts.pop()
            if start.left:
                starts.append(start.left)
            if start.right:
                starts.append(start.right)
            pending = [(start, 0)]
            while pending:
                node, total = pending.pop()
                total += node.val
                result += total == targetSum
                for child in (node.left, node.right):
                    if child:
                        pending.append((child, total))
        return result

items.title: 1. 固定次數向量
items.text:
時間： O(26n+m)

空間： O(26) 另加輸出

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Fixed count vectors
    Time: O(26n+m)
    Space: O(26) plus output
    """

    def findAnagrams(self, s: str, p: str) -> list[int]:
        need, have = [0] * 26, [0] * 26
        for char in p:
            need[ord(char) - 97] += 1
        answer = []
        for i, char in enumerate(s):
            have[ord(char) - 97] += 1
            if i >= len(p):
                have[ord(s[i - len(p)]) - 97] -= 1
            if i >= len(p) - 1 and have == need:
                answer.append(i - len(p) + 1)
        return answer

items.title: 2. 缺額式視窗
items.text:
時間： O(n+m) 期望

空間： O(alphabet) 另加輸出

from collections import Counter


class Solution:
    """Approach: Deficit-based window
    Time: O(n+m) expected
    Space: O(alphabet) plus output
    """

    def findAnagrams(self, s: str, p: str) -> list[int]:
        need = Counter(p)
        missing = len(p)
        answer = []
        for i, char in enumerate(s):
            if need[char] > 0:
                missing -= 1
            need[char] -= 1
            if i >= len(p):
                outgoing = s[i - len(p)]
                need[outgoing] += 1
                if need[outgoing] > 0:
                    missing += 1
            if i >= len(p) - 1 and missing == 0:
                answer.append(i - len(p) + 1)
        return answer

items.title: 1. 原地讀寫指標
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(1) 輔助空間

from itertools import groupby


class Solution:
    """Approach: In-place read and write pointers
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(1) auxiliary
    """

    def compress(self, chars: list[str]) -> int:
        read = write = 0
        while read < len(chars):
            end = read + 1
            while end < len(chars) and chars[end] == chars[read]:
                end += 1
            chars[write] = chars[read]
            write += 1
            count = end - read
            if count > 1:
                place = 1
                while place * 10 <= count:
                    place *= 10
                while place:
                    digit, count = divmod(count, place)
                    chars[write] = chr(ord("0") + digit)
                    write += 1
                    place //= 10
            read = end
        return write

items.title: 2. 緩衝區游程編碼
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(n)；教學基準超過 O(1) 輔助空間目標

from itertools import groupby


class Solution:
    """Approach: Buffered run encoding
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n); educational baseline exceeding the O(1) auxiliary-space goal
    """

    def compress(self, chars: list[str]) -> int:
        output = []
        for char, group in groupby(chars):
            count = sum(1 for _ in group)
            output.append(char)
            if count > 1:
                output.extend(str(count))
        chars[:] = output
        return len(output)

請先閱讀各解法的限制與輸入修改說明。教學基準解法可能超過題目要求的成本上限；第一種為預設實作。

items.title: 以公差為鍵的終點表
items.text: 依終點與公差保存長度至少二的子序列計數。新數對建立一個狀態，只有延伸既有狀態才加入所求答案。

items.title: 明確最後數對遞推
items.text: 令 pairs[j][i] 為最後位置 j、i、長度至少三的計數。列舉較早且值為 2*nums[j]-nums[i] 的 k，加入新三元組及先前所有以 k、j 結尾的子序列。

items.title: 以公差為鍵的終點表
items.text: 每個長度至少三的等差子序列，都唯一由移除最後位置而來。剩餘狀態公差相同；只計延伸，便能排除單純數對。

items.title: 明確最後數對遞推
items.text: 每個計入序列都有唯一倒數第二配對；其倒數第三位置必有推導值，且序列不是該三元組本身，就是從較早配對的較長序列延伸。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text:
以公差為鍵的終點表：時間 O(n^2)，期望值；空間 O(n^2)。 明確最後數對遞推：時間 最差 O(n^3)；空間 O(n^2)。

兩法保留 nums，支援負公差及重複值。明確數對基準在 n=1000 附近可能逾時，尤其全等值時，應使用平方級預設法。字典查詢為期望固定時間。

items.title: 1. 以公差為鍵的終點表
items.text:
時間： O(n^2)，期望值

空間： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Endpoint maps keyed by common difference
    Time: O(n^2) expected
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        ending = [{} for _ in nums]
        answer = 0
        for end, value in enumerate(nums):
            for previous in range(end):
                difference = value - nums[previous]
                extensions = ending[previous].get(difference, 0)
                answer += extensions
                ending[end][difference] = ending[end].get(difference, 0) + extensions + 1
        return answer

items.title: 2. 明確最後數對遞推
items.text:
時間： 最差 O(n^3)

空間： O(n^2)

class Solution:
    """Approach: Explicit final-pair recurrence
    Time: O(n^3) worst case
    Space: O(n^2)
    """

    def numberOfArithmeticSlices(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        positions = {}
        for index, value in enumerate(nums):
            positions.setdefault(value, []).append(index)
        pairs = [[0] * len(nums) for _ in nums]
        answer = 0
        for end in range(len(nums)):
            for previous in range(end):
                required = 2 * nums[previous] - nums[end]
                for earlier in positions.get(required, ()):
                    if earlier >= previous:
                        break
                    pairs[previous][end] += 1 + pairs[earlier][previous]
                answer += pairs[previous][end]
        return answer

items.title: 1. 前序值與祖先堆疊
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Codec:
    """Approach: Preorder values and ancestor stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def serialize(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> str:
        result = []
        stack = [root] if root else []
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            result.append(str(node.val))
            if node.right:
                stack.append(node.right)
            if node.left:
                stack.append(node.left)
        return ",".join(result)

    def deserialize(self, data: str) -> TreeNode | None:
        if not data:
            return None
        values = list(map(int, data.split(",")))
        root = TreeNode(values[0])
        stack = [root]
        for value in values[1:]:
            node = TreeNode(value)
            if value < stack[-1].val:
                stack[-1].left = node
            else:
                parent = stack[-1]
                while stack and value > stack[-1].val:
                    parent = stack.pop()
                parent.right = node
            stack.append(node)
        return root

items.title: 2. 後序值與反向堆疊
items.text:
時間： O(n)

空間： O(n)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Codec:
    """Approach: Postorder values and reversed stack
    Time: O(n)
    Space: O(n)
    """

    def serialize(self, root: TreeNode | None) -> str:
        result = []
        stack = [(root, False)] if root else []
        while stack:
            node, expanded = stack.pop()
            if expanded:
                result.append(str(node.val))
            else:
                stack.append((node, True))
                if node.right:
                    stack.append((node.right, False))
                if node.left:
                    stack.append((node.left, False))
        return ",".join(result)

    def deserialize(self, data: str) -> TreeNode | None:
        if not data:
            return None
        values = list(map(int, data.split(",")))
        root = TreeNode(values[-1])
        stack = [root]
        for value in reversed(values[:-1]):
            node = TreeNode(value)
            if value > stack[-1].val:
                stack[-1].right = node
            else:
                parent = stack[-1]
                while stack and value < stack[-1].val:
                    parent = stack.pop()
                parent.left = node
            stack.append(node)
        return root

  2. 有兩個子節點時，可以提升中序後繼，也可把右子樹接到左子樹最大節點之後。

請先閱讀各解法的限制與輸入修改說明。教學基準解法可能超過題目要求的成本上限；第一種為預設實作。

items.title: 實體提升後繼節點
items.text: 迭代找到目標及其父節點。若目標有兩個子節點，就把右子樹最小節點從原位置拆下，將這個原節點實際搬到目標位置，而不是覆寫其他節點的值。

items.title: 提升左子樹並嫁接
items.text: 目標有兩個子節點時，提升整棵左子樹，並將原右子樹接到左子樹最大節點的 right。

items.title: 實體提升後繼節點
items.text: 後繼大於所有左子樹值，且不大於其餘右子樹值，因此可合法取代目標。後繼原位置沒有左子節點，拆下時只需提升其可能存在的右子節點，就能保留原排序。

items.title: 提升左子樹並嫁接
items.text: 右子樹所有值都大於目標，因此也大於左子樹所有值。將它接在左子樹最大值之後，不違反任何二元搜尋樹界限，且所有剩餘節點仍可抵達。

items.title: 範例推演
items.text: 刪除根 4，其左側為葉節點 2，右子樹根為 7 且左子節點為 5。可提升 5 取代 4；也可提升 2，再把原右子樹接到 2 之後。

items.title: 複雜度與常見錯誤
items.text: 兩者皆為 O(h) 時間、O(1) 空間，修改指標、保留所有剩餘節點的身份與數值，並避免遞迴。合法結果的樹形不一定唯一。刪除原根時可能產生新的根參考，所以必須回傳更新後的根。

items.title: Python 實作
items.text: 每個程式區塊都能獨立使用，並採用 LeetCode 的類別名稱。選一個貼入 Python3 編輯器；需要時已附共用節點定義。兩種語言共用完全相同的程式。

items.title: 1. 實體提升後繼節點
items.text:
時間： O(h)

空間： O(1)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Physical successor promotion
    Time: O(h)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def deleteNode(self, root: TreeNode | None, key: int) -> TreeNode | None:
        parent, node = None, root
        while node and node.val != key:
            parent = node
            node = node.left if key < node.val else node.right
        if node is None:
            return root
        if node.left and node.right:
            successor_parent, successor = node, node.right
            while successor.left:
                successor_parent, successor = successor, successor.left
            if successor_parent is not node:
                successor_parent.left = successor.right
                successor.right = node.right
            successor.left = node.left
            replacement = successor
        else:
            replacement = node.left or node.right
        if parent is None:
            return replacement
        if parent.left is node:
            parent.left = replacement
        else:
            parent.right = replacement
        return root

items.title: 2. 提升左子樹並嫁接
items.text:
時間： O(h)

空間： O(1)

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right


class Solution:
    """Approach: Left-subtree promotion and graft
    Time: O(h)
    Space: O(1)
    """

    def deleteNode(self, root: TreeNode | None, key: int) -> TreeNode | None:
        dummy = TreeNode(right=root)
        parent, node = dummy, root
        while node and node.val != key:
            parent = node
            node = node.left if key < node.val else node.right
        if node is None:
            return root
        replacement = node.right
        if node.left:
            replacement = node.left
            maximum = replacement
            while maximum.right:
                maximum = maximum.right
            maximum.right = node.right
        if parent.left is node:
            parent.left = replacement
        else:
            parent.right = replacement
        return dummy.right
